requirements.title: Use RFC8441 semantics for Extended CONNECT pseudo-headers and setting
requirements.statement: The semantics of the pseudo-header fields and setting MUST be identical to those in HTTP/2 as defined in RFC8441.
notes: Trimmed to the testable invariant while preserving the RFC8441 dependency.

requirements.title: Set SETTINGS_ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL to 0x08
requirements.statement: The SETTINGS_ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL value MUST be 0x08 (decimal 8).
notes: Kept the exact wire value and removed explanatory padding.

requirements.title: Respond to unsupported Extended CONNECT protocols
requirements.statement: If a server advertises support for Extended CONNECT but receives an Extended CONNECT request with an unknown or unsupported ":protocol" value, the server SHOULD respond with a 501 (Not Implemented) status code.
notes: Preserved the non-normative status code recommendation as written.

requirements.title: Provide optional problem-details information
requirements.statement: A server MAY provide more information via a "problem details" response.
notes: Kept the optional extension as a single permissive requirement.

requirements.title: Represent orderly closures with FIN
requirements.statement: Orderly TCP-level closures MUST be represented as a FIN bit on the stream.
notes: Kept the closure encoding rule as a standalone invariant.

requirements.title: Represent RST exceptions with request-cancelled errors
requirements.statement: RST exceptions MUST be represented with a stream error of type H3_REQUEST_CANCELLED.
notes: Kept the required error mapping and removed extra citation detail.

requirements.title: Assign SETTINGS_ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL value 0x08
requirements.statement: The SETTINGS_ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL setting MUST have value 0x08.
notes: Registry assignment is independently testable from the default value.

requirements.title: Set the default for SETTINGS_ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL to 0
requirements.statement: The SETTINGS_ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL setting MUST have default value 0.
notes: Default selection is independently testable from the registry value.

requirements.title: Parse WebSocket tunnel messages
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 WebSocket tunnel parser MUST expose complete unmasked text, binary, and control messages from WebSocket frames carried on an RFC9220 Extended CONNECT stream.
notes: This parser is the first reusable WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 tunnel component and does not dispatch application handlers.

requirements.title: Reject unmasked client WebSocket frames
requirements.statement: The server-side HTTP/3 WebSocket tunnel parser MUST reject unmasked client frames.
notes: Masking enforcement is endpoint-role dependent; this requirement covers the server receiving client bytes.

requirements.title: Reject masked server WebSocket frames
requirements.statement: The client-side HTTP/3 WebSocket tunnel parser MUST reject masked server frames.
notes: Masking enforcement is endpoint-role dependent; this requirement covers the client receiving server bytes.

requirements.title: Reassemble fragmented WebSocket data messages
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 WebSocket tunnel parser MUST reassemble fragmented text and binary messages across continuation frames before surfacing them to callers.
notes: Frame split buffering and message fragmentation are both covered because HTTP/3 stream reads can split either boundary.

requirements.title: Reject invalid WebSocket continuation state
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 WebSocket tunnel parser MUST reject invalid continuation state, including orphan continuations and incomplete fragmented messages at stream end.
notes: The parser maps invalid WebSocket message sequencing to HTTP/3 message errors for the tunnel stream.

requirements.title: Validate WebSocket control-frame constraints
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 WebSocket tunnel parser MUST enforce control-frame finality and payload-size constraints while permitting control messages between fragmented data frames.
notes: This requirement keeps control-frame validation in the tunnel parser rather than the QUIC transport runtime.

requirements.title: Validate WebSocket text message UTF-8
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 WebSocket tunnel parser MUST reject complete text messages that are not valid UTF-8.
notes: UTF-8 validation runs when a complete text message is surfaced, including fragmented messages after reassembly.

requirements.title: Parse WebSocket close status payloads
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 WebSocket tunnel close parser MUST validate transmitted close status codes and UTF-8 close reasons.
notes: This slice parses close payloads for standalone validation and for the handler close echo helper.

requirements.title: Dispatch accepted WebSocket tunnels to application handlers
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server MUST dispatch validated RFC9220 WebSocket Extended CONNECT request streams to an application WebSocket tunnel handler after sending a successful tunnel response without ending the stream.
notes: This slice connects the validated Extended CONNECT request path to an application handler that owns the tunnel stream. It does not implement TCP socket forwarding or live external-peer proof.

requirements.title: Echo WebSocket close frames on accepted tunnels
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server WebSocket tunnel context MUST let application handlers read client WebSocket messages, write unmasked server WebSocket messages, and echo a received close frame before completing the writable side of the stream with FIN.
notes: This slice covers the accepted server tunnel helper path for close echo and orderly write completion. Broader application close-code selection and external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof remain separate work.

requirements.title: Echo WebSocket ping frames as pong frames
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server WebSocket tunnel context MUST let application handlers reply to received ping control messages with unmasked pong control messages carrying the same payload while preserving the tunnel for subsequent messages.
notes: This slice covers the accepted server tunnel helper path for ping-to-pong responses and continued tunnel use. Automatic keepalive scheduling and external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof remain separate work.

requirements.title: Write application-selected WebSocket close frames on accepted tunnels
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server WebSocket tunnel context MUST let application handlers write an unmasked close control frame with an application-selected valid close status and optional UTF-8 reason before completing the writable side of the stream with FIN.
notes: This slice covers the accepted server tunnel helper path for explicit application close frames and orderly write completion. Automatic close-code mapping for handler exceptions, TCP socket forwarding, keepalive scheduling, and external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof remain separate work.

requirements.title: Map malformed WebSocket tunnel frames to protocol-error close frames
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server WebSocket tunnel context MUST let application handlers opt into reading the next client message such that WebSocket parser `MESSAGE_ERROR` failures write an unmasked close frame with status code 1002 before completing the writable side of the stream with FIN and rethrowing the parser failure.
notes: This slice covers an explicit handler opt-in helper for malformed WebSocket frame handling after the tunnel is accepted. Automatic close-code mapping for arbitrary handler exceptions, TCP socket forwarding, keepalive scheduling, and external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof remain separate work.

requirements.title: Send server WebSocket ping frames on accepted tunnels
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server WebSocket tunnel context MUST let application handlers write an unmasked ping control frame with a caller-supplied payload while preserving the accepted tunnel for a later pong response and subsequent data messages.
notes: This slice covers an explicit server ping helper for accepted tunnels and continued tunnel use after a pong and later data message. Automatic keepalive scheduling, TCP socket forwarding, and external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof remain separate work.

requirements.title: Map WebSocket handler exceptions to internal-error close frames
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server MUST map unexpected application handler exceptions on an accepted RFC 9220 WebSocket tunnel to an unmasked close control frame with status code 1011 before completing the writable side of the stream.
notes: This slice covers default framework-level mapping for unexpected application handler exceptions after the WebSocket tunnel has already been accepted. Configurable exception close policy, TCP socket forwarding, automatic keepalive scheduling, and external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof remain separate work.

requirements.title: Send configured WebSocket keepalive pings on accepted tunnels
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server MUST send automatic unmasked WebSocket ping control frames on accepted RFC 9220 tunnels when a positive keepalive interval is configured, without blocking subsequent application tunnel data.
notes: This slice covers the opt-in server keepalive scheduler for accepted tunnels. TCP socket forwarding, external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof, and richer application-specific keepalive payload policy remain separate work.

requirements.title: Forward WebSocket binary tunnels through TCP streams
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server MUST let application handlers forward accepted RFC 9220 WebSocket tunnel binary messages to a connected TCP stream and return TCP response bytes as unmasked binary WebSocket messages while preserving WebSocket close handling.
notes: This slice covers basic TCP stream forwarding through the accepted server tunnel helper. TCP target policy, forwarding stress, external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof, and richer application-specific close-code or keepalive policy remain separate work.

requirements.title: Send configured WebSocket keepalive ping payloads
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server MUST send the configured WebSocket keepalive payload in automatic unmasked ping control frames on accepted RFC 9220 tunnels while preserving subsequent tunnel data.
notes: This slice covers static keepalive ping payload policy for accepted tunnels. Dynamic per-ping payload selection, external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof, and application-specific exception-to-close-code policy remain separate work.

requirements.title: Configure WebSocket handler exception close policy
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server MUST let application owners configure the WebSocket close status code and reason used for unexpected accepted RFC 9220 tunnel handler exceptions while preserving orderly tunnel write completion.
notes: This slice covers static server-level close status and reason policy for unexpected accepted tunnel handler exceptions. Dynamic per-exception close-code mapping is covered by `REQ-QUIC-RFC9220-0028`; external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof and TCP proxy stress/backpressure remain separate work.

requirements.title: Map WebSocket handler exceptions to dynamic close policies
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 server MUST let application owners map unexpected accepted RFC 9220 tunnel handler exceptions to WebSocket close status code and reason policies while preserving static fallback policy and orderly tunnel write completion.
notes: This slice covers dynamic exception-aware close status and reason selection for unexpected accepted tunnel handler exceptions. External WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof and TCP proxy stress/backpressure remain separate work.

requirements.title: Bound TCP response chunks for WebSocket TCP forwarding
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 WebSocket TCP forwarder MUST let application handlers configure a positive TCP read buffer size and return TCP response bytes as unmasked binary WebSocket messages no larger than that configured buffer while preserving orderly WebSocket close handling.
notes: This slice covers bounded local TCP response chunk forwarding and backpressure-sensitive write sequencing. TCP target policy and external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof remain separate work.

requirements.title: Open client-side WebSocket Extended CONNECT tunnels
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 client WebSocket helper MUST send RFC 9220 Extended CONNECT request headers with `:protocol` `websocket`, require local SETTINGS_ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL advertisement before opening the tunnel, mask client-to-server WebSocket frames, read unmasked server-to-client WebSocket messages, and expose the successful tunnel response headers without waiting for stream FIN.
notes: This slice covers a local HTTP/3 client helper that opens an accepted RFC 9220 WebSocket tunnel and then exposes WebSocket message IO on the live request stream. External peer proof and production proxy policy remain separate work.

requirements.title: Carry WebSocket tunnel negotiation headers
requirements.statement: The HTTP/3 WebSocket tunnel helpers MUST let callers send additional non-pseudo request headers on RFC 9220 Extended CONNECT requests and let applications add response headers to accepted WebSocket tunnel responses before WebSocket bytes are exchanged.
notes: This slice covers subprotocol-style request and accepted-response metadata over the repository HTTP/3 WebSocket tunnel helpers. The helper still owns all Extended CONNECT pseudo-fields.
